maddeler.e:
أنخرق (form VII)
# أَنْخَرِقُ (ʔanḵariqu) /ʔan.xa.ri.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
# أَنْخَرِقَ (ʔanḵariqa) /ʔan.xa.ri.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
# أَنْخَرِقْ (ʔanḵariq) /ʔan.xa.riq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
